plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Skills for working with superpowers implementation plans — refine-plan runs an independent second-pass review-and-fix on a freshly written plan.

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: Skills for cleaning up pull requests — collapse-noise marks formatter/lint and import-path-only files as Viewed so reviewers see only the substantive diffs.

plugins.name: gcp
plugins.description: Skills that wrap the gcloud CLI to analyze Google Cloud operational and security signals — waf-false-positives finds Cloud Armor WAF false positives, and error-digest produces a weekly Cloud Error Reporting digest of new and spiking error groups.
